say:1:1623445001:1.text: We're not here to chase some cheap scoop like the others. We want to help!
say:1:1623445001:1.source_cn: 我们和其他记者不一样，我们是真心想帮助大家的！

say:2:1623445002:1.text: Help? Every reporter says that first. Then the article comes out, and it's either a punchline or a hatchet job.
say:2:1623445002:1.source_cn: 帮助？每个记者开头都这么说。可最后的报道，不是嘲笑就是曲解。

say:3:1623445003:1.text: Olaya is watching you like a hawk. You can tell right away that a gentle "just a few questions" approach isn't going to work in this atmosphere.
say:3:1623445003:1.source_cn: 眼前的奥莱雅对记者充满警惕，你敏锐地察觉到，温和的询问...
say:3:1623445003:1.male: Olaya is watching you like a hawk. You can tell right away that a gentle "just a few questions" approach isn't going to work in this atmosphere.
say:3:1623445003:1.female: Olaya is watching you like a hawk. You can tell right away that a gentle "just a few questions" approach isn't going to work in this atmosphere.

say:4:1623445004:1.text: If anything's going to work, it's a small jolt, the kind that snaps the conversation out of its rut.
say:4:1623445004:1.source_cn: 或许，一点恰到好处的刺激，反而能打开局面。

say:6:1623445005:1.text: I get why you're wary of reporters. But by the same logic, you should get why we might have questions about a bunch of people calling itself a "support group".
say:6:1623445005:1.source_cn: 我能理解你对记者的偏见，就像我们也会对“互助团队”这个...

say:9:1623445007:1.text: Look, whether it was the magic contract mess or that speech loss episode, it feels like the students were driven by the same kind of mental pressure. Something pushed them into it.
say:9:1623445007:1.source_cn: 在我看来，无论是魔力契约还是失语症，学生们都因为某种心...

say:10:1623445008:1.text: The support group is student-run. It's just students helping students. No other agenda!
say:10:1623445008:1.source_cn: 互助团队是学生自发组织的，纯粹是为了互助，没有其他目的！

choice_prompt:11:1623445008.text: The support group is student-run. It's just students helping students. No other agenda!
choice_prompt:11:1623445008.source_cn: 互助团队是学生自发组织的，纯粹是为了互助，没有其他目的！

say:13:1623445011:1.text: You think you can walk in with "interview" stamped on your forehead and expect everyone to spill their guts? Nobody owes you that!
say:13:1623445011:1.source_cn: 你们打着采访的名义，就可以让任何人向你们张开心扉吗？我...
say:13:1623445011:1.male: You think you can walk in with "interview" stamped on your forehead and expect everyone to spill their guts? Nobody owes you that!
say:13:1623445011:1.female: You think you can walk in with "interview" stamped on your forehead and expect everyone to spill their guts? Nobody owes you that!

say:14:1623445012:1.text: We shouldn't write each other off. I don't think you're the same as that "Grand Mentor", but you still need to show us who you are, and we need the chance to show you who we are as well!
say:14:1623445012:1.source_cn: 我们不该对彼此产生偏见，我认为你与“大导师”不同，但你...

say:15:1623445013:1.text: So you're putting me in the same box as that fraud?
say:15:1623445013:1.source_cn: 所以你把我和那种骗子相提并论？

choice_prompt:16:1623445013.text: So you're putting me in the same box as that fraud?
choice_prompt:16:1623445013.source_cn: 所以你把我和那种骗子相提并论？

say:17:1623445014:1.text: Right. When you start with the conclusion, everything afterward just becomes proof for it.
say:17:1623445014:1.source_cn: 没错，先入为主的偏见会影响判断。

say:20:1623445015:1.text: Olaya goes quiet for a second. She sizes you up with sharp eyes, but she doesn't argue back.
say:20:1623445015:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅一时语塞，她用锐利的目光扫过你们，却并未反驳。
say:20:1623445015:1.male: Olaya goes quiet for a second. She sizes you up with sharp eyes, but she doesn't argue back.
say:20:1623445015:1.female: Olaya goes quiet for a second. She sizes you up with sharp eyes, but she doesn't argue back.

say:21:1623445016:1.text: She's listening now, whether she wants to admit it or not. Time to be straight with her.
say:21:1623445016:1.source_cn: 你意识到，这沉默或许是她愿意聆听的信号。是时候表明你们...
say:21:1623445016:1.male: She's listening now, whether she wants to admit it or not. Time to be straight with her.
say:21:1623445016:1.female: She's listening now, whether she wants to admit it or not. Time to be straight with her.

choice_prompt:22:1623445016.male: She's listening now, whether she wants to admit it or not. Time to be straight with her.
choice_prompt:22:1623445016.female: She's listening now, whether she wants to admit it or not. Time to be straight with her.

say:23:1623445017:1.text: Yeah. Your mana's fine, but you're still showing up for these students. That tells me we might not be so different after all.
say:23:1623445017:1.source_cn: 是的，你的魔力依旧完好，却愿意帮助他们。在这一点上，我...

say:25:1623445018:1.text: Trust us. We're on your side. We want the students here to recover and get back on their feet.
say:25:1623445018:1.source_cn: 相信我们，我们和你立场相同，都希望让莱希拉姆的同学们更...

say:26:1623445019:1.text: Alright. You want to ask questions, go ahead. Just don't expect me to play nice. I'll answer what I want, and I'll stop when I'm done.
say:26:1623445019:1.source_cn: 好吧……既然你们要采访，那就问吧。至于回答不回答，看我心情。
say:26:1623445019:1.male: Alright. You want to ask questions, go ahead. Just don't expect me to play nice. I'll answer what I want, and I'll stop when I'm done.
say:26:1623445019:1.female: Alright. You want to ask questions, go ahead. Just don't expect me to play nice. I'll answer what I want, and I'll stop when I'm done.

say:29:1623445020:0.text: From what I've seen, their mana isn't gone—not completely, and not in most cases. What's actually happening is that they've lost interest in magic.
say:29:1623445020:0.source_cn: 我所接触的学生，魔力损失者不算太多，并没有彻底失去魔力...
say:29:1623445020:0.male: From what I've seen, their mana isn't gone—not completely, and not in most cases. What's actually happening is that they've lost interest in magic.
say:29:1623445020:0.female: From what I've seen, their mana isn't gone—not completely, and not in most cases. What's actually happening is that they've lost interest in magic.

say:30:1623445021:0.text: And when their mana drops, everything drops with it. Their grades, their confidence, their patience. The pressure and gossip wear them down, and eventually they begin to resent school altogether.
say:30:1623445021:0.source_cn: 他们魔力衰退导致学业退步，又无法得到周边人们的理解，被...
say:30:1623445021:0.male: And when their mana drops, everything drops with it. Their grades, their confidence, their patience. The pressure and gossip wear them down, and eventually they begin to resent school altogether.
say:30:1623445021:0.female: And when their mana drops, everything drops with it. Their grades, their confidence, their patience. The pressure and gossip wear them down, and eventually they begin to resent school altogether.

choice:28:0:1.text: (Ask how the mana-damaged students are doing)
choice:28:0:1.male: (Ask how the mana-damaged students are doing)
choice:28:0:1.female: (Ask how the mana-damaged students are doing)

say:31:1623445022:0.text: Most of the mana-damaged fall into two groups. One group is done. They've decided magic is the problem, the school is the problem, and the only way to cope is to shut it all out.
say:31:1623445022:0.source_cn: 魔力受损的学生大多分为两种，一种是自暴自弃型，认为学校...
say:31:1623445022:0.male: Most of the mana-damaged fall into two groups. One group is done. They've decided magic is the problem, the school is the problem, and the only way to cope is to shut it all out.
say:31:1623445022:0.female: Most of the mana-damaged fall into two groups. One group is done. They've decided magic is the problem, the school is the problem, and the only way to cope is to shut it all out.

say:32:1623445023:0.text: The other group looks just as bad from the outside, but they're different inside. They still want a way back. They just don't know how to find it.
say:32:1623445023:0.source_cn: 另一种其实和前者很相似，但区别是他们虽然状态很差，内心...
say:32:1623445023:0.male: The other group looks just as bad from the outside, but they're different inside. They still want a way back. They just don't know how to find it.
say:32:1623445023:0.female: The other group looks just as bad from the outside, but they're different inside. They still want a way back. They just don't know how to find it.

say:33:1623445024:0.text: That's who we built this place for, to help students who are ready to step out of this and move forward.
say:33:1623445024:0.source_cn: 而互助团队的成立，就是为帮助这些想走出来的学生成立的。
say:33:1623445024:0.male: That's who we built this place for, to help students who are ready to step out of this and move forward.
say:33:1623445024:0.female: That's who we built this place for, to help students who are ready to step out of this and move forward.

say:37:1623445026:0.text: If I'm being honest, it's not doing much. Just look at those students.
say:37:1623445026:0.source_cn: 我没猜错的话……效果微乎其微，看看那些学生就知道了。

say:38:1623445027:0.text: You're welcome to have your own opinions, but don't you dare turn guesses into "facts" in print.
say:38:1623445027:0.source_cn: 你可以随意猜想，但绝不能把你的猜想写进文章。
say:38:1623445027:0.male: You're welcome to have your own opinions, but don't you dare turn guesses into "facts" in print.
say:38:1623445027:0.female: You're welcome to have your own opinions, but don't you dare turn guesses into "facts" in print.

say:40:1623445028:0.text: The school's busy putting out its own fires. Durella's arrest dragged half the board into the mud... So far, the only one who's checked in at all is Professor Zorya, and she only asked a couple questions.
say:40:1623445028:0.source_cn: 据说杜瑞拉被逮捕一事牵扯了很多人，校董事会层乱成一团…...
say:40:1623445028:0.male: The school's busy putting out its own fires. Durella's arrest dragged half the board into the mud... So far, the only one who's checked in at all is Professor Zorya, and she only asked a couple questions.
say:40:1623445028:0.female: The school's busy putting out its own fires. Durella's arrest dragged half the board into the mud... So far, the only one who's checked in at all is Professor Zorya, and she only asked a couple questions.

say:42:1623445029:1.text: What? That's all? No real support for the victims?
say:42:1623445029:1.source_cn: 什么？学校对受害者们没有任何实质性的关注或支持吗？！

say:43:1623445030:1.text: But that's the school's job. If they stay quiet, they're dumping the whole mess on students. Have you tried asking for funding?
say:43:1623445030:1.source_cn: 可……这应该是学校的责任！他们沉默，等于把烂摊子全扔给...

say:44:1623445031:1.text: You can tell Bel is trying to steer the conversation toward "blame the school". That's not why you came here, so you keep your reaction to yourself.
say:44:1623445031:1.source_cn: 你敏锐地察觉到，巴布正试图将问题的矛头引向莱希拉姆，这...
say:44:1623445031:1.male: You can tell Bel is trying to steer the conversation toward "blame the school". That's not why you came here, so you keep your reaction to yourself.
say:44:1623445031:1.female: You can tell Bel is trying to steer the conversation toward "blame the school." That's not why you came here, so you keep your reaction to yourself.

say:45:1623445032:1.text: When we've actually got results to show, I'll go ask.
say:45:1623445032:1.source_cn: 等我们做出些像样的成果……我自然会去申请。

say:46:1623445033:1.text: I've said enough. You can leave now.
say:46:1623445033:1.source_cn: 我觉得说得已经够多了，你们现在可以离开了吗？
say:46:1623445033:1.male: I've said enough. You can leave now.
say:46:1623445033:1.female: I've said enough. You can leave now.

say:48:1623445034:1.text: Wait, can we talk a bit more? I want to write something about this. If people see your work, maybe the new headmistress will notice. Maybe more students will join and help.
say:48:1623445034:1.source_cn: 等等，能再多聊聊吗？我想写一篇报道，也许这能让新校长、...

say:49:1623445035:1.text: That's a naive way of thinking. If only reality were that simple.
say:49:1623445035:1.source_cn: 你的想法天真得像个以为只要浇水花就一定会开的孩子。现实...

say:50:1623445036:1.text: And hiding from the world fixes what, exactly? You turn this place into a little sealed bubble, shut the door on everyone, and then just watch the "magic is poison" mood spread across campus. That's your idea of helping?
say:50:1623445036:1.source_cn: 那回避又有什么意义？把互助小组变成隔绝外界的避难所，眼...

say:51:1623445037:1.text: No... Nobody here actually hates magic. They're hurting because they loved it too much, and now it feels like it betrayed them.
say:51:1623445037:1.source_cn: 不……这里没有人真正讨厌魔法。他们正是因为比谁都热爱魔...

say:52:1623445038:1.text: They came here because they're still trying to patch themselves back together. Because they still have hope!
say:52:1623445038:1.source_cn: 他们聚集在这里，是因为还想治好心里的病，还抱着希望！

say:53:1623445039:1.text: Because they used to love it...

say:54:1623445040:1.text: The interview is over. Leave. We don't need outsiders standing here judging us.
say:54:1623445040:1.source_cn: 采访结束了，现在请你们离开。这里不欢迎只会指手画脚的旁观者。
say:54:1623445040:1.male: The interview is over. Leave. We don't need outsiders standing here judging us.
say:54:1623445040:1.female: The interview is over. Leave. We don't need outsiders standing here judging us.

choice:28:3:4.text: So what does the school think about your group?
choice:28:3:4.source_cn: 学校对你们有什么看法？
choice:28:3:4.male: So what does the school think about your group?
choice:28:3:4.female: So what does the school think about your group?

choice:22:1:2.text: Maybe we're here for the same reason you are.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 也许我们的目的与你一样
choice:22:1:2.male: Maybe we're here for the same reason you are.
choice:22:1:2.female: Maybe we're here for the same reason you are.

choice:16:0:1.text: No. We're saying bias works both ways.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 我们只想说明什么是偏见
choice:16:0:1.male: No. We're saying bias works both ways.
choice:16:0:1.female: No. We're saying bias works both ways.

choice:16:1:2.text: Only if you put us in the same box as every other reporter.
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 你也不该认为我们和别的记者一样
choice:16:1:2.male: Only if you put us in the same box as every other reporter.
choice:16:1:2.female: Only if you put us in the same box as every other reporter.

choice:11:0:1.text: Our interviews are the same. No agenda.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我们的采访也没有其他目的
choice:11:0:1.male: Our interviews are the same. No agenda.
choice:11:0:1.female: Our interviews are the same. No agenda.
